status: Experiment 2 of 3 (budget). Frozen BEFORE the Exp2 holdout look. Exp1 (relayfix gate) is complete and unchanged.

why_exp2_exists.exp1_emission_duplicate: The preregistered Exp1 audit emission (corridor_v1 repaired, h69-relayfix-v1-35235-20261020T202813Z-a2917d46-zeros.tif, sha256 13b3fe7bdda7690bd1b4306a6a068748b4ec78e44378aa3903a899956d94a9ce) measures 0.8911 of dots within 3 px of the archived 2026-10-12 H69 lane raster (jaccard 0.7410) and 0.8880 vs H69-D. Per protocol rule 1 (>70% = duplicate) it is logged DUPLICATE-AND-STOP as a candidate; bytes retained for audit only.
why_exp2_exists.selector_defect: The capped corridor selector sorts dilatational pairs first, so 1200/1200 production corridors are pull-apart and 0 are transfer-overlap in both the archived census and the repaired census (evidence/relayfix_census.json). The lane prompt explicitly requires transfer-zone corridors, and overlapping hard-linked relays are a major hot geometry in the cited inventory. The transfer population exists in the 383,827 repaired pairs but is never emitted.

hypothesis.statement: Reserving half the 1200-corridor cap for transfer-overlap corridors (overlap > 0.5W pairs, oblique-connector geometry) alongside dilatational pull-apart/relay corridors ranks withheld faults at least as well as the dilatational-only selector, because overlapping relays host the breaching faults of hard-linked ramps; the resulting dot field is also spatially distinct from prior lane emissions.
hypothesis.non_fault_mimic: Contractional overlap zones can host pressure ridges / restraining-bend uplift lineaments and shoreline scarps that mimic breaching faults without through-going permeable structure.
hypothesis.selector: From repaired build_tip_pairs: dedup by (strand pair, W, along) after _priority sort within each subtype (dilatational flag from TipPair), take up to 600 dilatational + up to 600 non-dilatational (transfer-overlap); if one group is short, backfill from the other to 1200. Scoring v1 (archived weights), S0=0.75, identical evidence/allocator/flank/active rules as Exp1.

gates.distinctness_precheck: Before the holdout, full-catalogue balanced dots must measure <0.70 dot-overlap (3 px) against BOTH archived H69 lane rasters and rho <0.90 (subsample diagnostic; exact vendor scan follows on final bytes). If the precheck fails, Exp2 aborts and the session deliverable is the Exp1 negative/duplicate log.
gates.prompt_gate: balanced pooled DTI > control pooled DTI with paired-bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0 (beat the same pipeline without corridor priors).
gates.promotion_gate: balanced pooled DTI > corridor_v1 pooled DTI with CI lower bound > 0 AND complete literal two-phase uniqueness AND format/canary/manifest gates (scripts/release_gate.py). Anything else = negative verdict, no public download, no slot.
gates.emission: The balanced arm is the session's unique audit TIF (Exp3 emission step). v2/v3 from Exp1 remain non-selectable sensitivities.
